sourceBreakdowns.title: FEMA FY2024 DRF obligations by month
sourceBreakdowns.basis: FEMA's final FY2024 Disaster Relief Fund report publishes $39.066B of actual obligations by month as of September 30, before final closeout. The 12 monthly rows reconcile exactly at the source's $1M precision. Obligations are a separate operational measure, not additive children of Treasury's $33.275B Disaster Relief cash-outlay classification or the Combined Statement's $29.498B DRF-account net outlay.
